user.biography: Dr. Piyanart Ekworapoj is a Lecturer in the Department of General Dentistry at Srinakharinwirot University . With over twenty-five years of experience in both academia and clinical practice as dental specialist in operative dentistry, her expertise lies in dental laser and materials related restorative and prosthodontic dentistry. Specializing in the field of Health Tech, she focuses on the innovation and development of advanced dental materials. Dr. Ekworapoj bridges the gap between academic research and commercial application, holding more than 10 patents and petty patents for novel biomaterials.
